  • Uses of MCS in org.openscience.cdk.isomorphism

    Methods in org.openscience.cdk.isomorphism that return MCS
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    static MCS
    MCS.find(IAtomContainer query)
    Create an MCS search for the query with the default matching and no time limit.
    MCS
    MCS.withCompleteRings()
    Map rings only whole: a ring atom or ring bond of either molecule is in the common substructure only as part of a ring of that molecule whose bonds are all common.
    MCS
    MCS.withDisconnected(int minBonds)
    Find a maximum common edge subgraph [Raymond02 (not found in db)] instead: the mapping with the most common bonds and, of those, the most atoms.
    MCS
    MCS.withMatching(Expr.Type... opts)
    Match atoms and bonds with the expressions that QueryAtomContainer.create(IAtomContainer, Expr.Type...) makes from the query and opts, at the start of each search.
    MCS
    MCS.withStereochemistry()
    Check stereochemistry: a mapping must keep the configuration of each tetrahedral centre and double bond that both molecules specify, as far as the mapped atoms fix it.
    MCS
    MCS.withTimeout(long time, TimeUnit unit)
    Stop each search that runs longer than the given time: MCS.match(IAtomContainer) and MCS.matchAll(IAtomContainer) then throw Intractable, while MCS.search(IAtomContainer) and MCS.searchAll(IAtomContainer) return the best mappings found so far, see MCS.Result.complete().
